children: Estonia retailer's Q3 revenue rose 8.2% yr/yr, driven by car segment growth
Profit before tax for Q3 declined 11.7% yr/yr
Supermarkets segment impacted by weak consumer environment and intensified competition
Company expects continued growth in Baltic car markets, with focus on expanding electric vehicle offerings
Group plans further investments in store network upgrades and energy efficiency initiatives
Company sees signs of improving economic environment, with growing customer orders in security and real estate segments
CAR SEGMENT GROWTH - Co said revenue growth was driven by recovery in Baltic automotive markets, increased new vehicle sales, strong after-sales business and integration of Tallinn Škoda dealerships

SUPERMARKETS PRESSURE - Co said supermarkets segment was affected by weak consumer environment, intensified competition and temporary sales disruptions from store openings, closures and renovation works

SECURITY SEGMENT GROWTH - Co said security segment revenue grew due to security technology projects and maintenance services, but profitability was limited by higher fuel prices and pressure in cash handling services
The stock recently traded at 19 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 20 three months ago
